title: Israelis vote in national election seen as a referendum on Netanyahu
detail: Israel held its national election on October 27, 2026, widely framed as a referendum on Prime Minister Netanyahu. The West Bank was closed for election day while the IDF operation in Hebron continued; Palestinian officials and some residents say the operation was politically timed.

media.caption: Israelis vote in a tense national election

title: UN commission of inquiry finds Israel continued genocide in Gaza after the truce
detail: A UN commission of inquiry report released October 27 found Israeli forces committed crimes against humanity and war crimes in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including targeting Palestinians in Gaza after the October 2025 ceasefire.

media.caption: UN commission finds Israel continued Gaza genocide after truce

title: Hebron raid displaces nearly 4,000 Palestinians; IDF chief reportedly saw no justification to continue
detail: The IDF operation in Hebron, launched after two soldiers were killed at a checkpoint, has displaced nearly 4,000 people per WAFA figures (local officials cite up to ~5,000). Israeli media report the IDF chief told Netanyahu there was no operational justification to keep residents from their homes, but the PM ordered the operation to continue.
